mPDF (Local Note)
=================
Upstream mPDF library for HTML-to-PDF rendering bundled with osTicket.

Contents
--------
- README.md, CHANGELOG.md, LICENSE.txt, CREDITS.txt – upstream documentation.
- data/ – CSS, fonts mapping, icc profiles, collations, and other data assets.
- src/ – PHP sources implementing mPDF.
- tmp/ – cache/temp working directory.
- ttfonts/ – bundled TrueType font licenses/info.
- .github/ – upstream contribution and CI resources.

Notes
-----
- Vendor code; avoid local modifications. Prefer upstream upgrades and verify PDF outputs after changes.
